==Description==
'''v1.33.0''' is the eighty-sixth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 25th of September 2024. It added a few balance changes to modes.

This update encompassed two versions, the main v1.33.0 update (released 25 September 2024) and the minor v1.33.0a update (released 25 September 2024).

==Additions==
*Modern [[Speedy Boss]]
*[[Settings#Show Tower Options|Show Tower Options]] setting
*New [[Codes|code]] obtained by purchasing a [[Patient Zero Mini Plush]]
**Code is unique for each [[Patient Zero Mini Plush]] bought
**Gives {{Color|Other|Patient Zero}} [[Accelerator]] skin

==Changes & Bugfixes==
===Towers===
*[[Paintballer]] unlock cost decreased from {{Coins|150}} to {{Coins|100}}.
*[[Demoman]] unlock cost decreased from {{Coins|250}} to {{Coins|200}}.

:In '''v1.33.0a''':
*Fixed not being able to select the [[Jester]]'s bombs.

===Enemies===
*[[Normal]] appearance changed.
*[[Speedy]] changed.
**Health buffed from 3 to 4 in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode.
**Appearance changed.
*[[Slow]] appearance changed.
*[[Normal Boss]] changed.
**Health buffed from 160 to 180 in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode.
**Appearance and animation changed.
*[[Hidden]] changed.
**Health buffed from 10 to 15 in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode.
**Appearance and animation changed.
*[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] changed.
**Health buffed from 250 to 300 in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode.
**First spawn in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode now spawns as a [[Boss]].
*[[Slow Boss]] changed.
**Health buffed from 1,600 to 1,750 in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode.
**Speed increased from 1.6 to 1.9.
**Appearance and animation changed.
*[[Hidden Boss]] changed.
**First spawn in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode now spawns as a [[Boss]].
**Appearance and animation changed.
*[[Bolt]] appearance and animation changed.
*[[Speedy Boss]] changed.
**Now appears in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] and [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] modes.
**Health decreased from 1,800 to 1,300.
**Now gives {{Money|5}} on death.
**Appearance and animation changed.
*[[Grave Digger]] changed.
**Health increased from 15,000 to 20,000.
**Cash given changed from {{Money|5,000}} every 20% health lost to {{Money|2,500}} every 10% health lost.
**''Summon'' ability can now summon [[Armored]]s.
**''Summon'' ability can no longer summon [[Normal]]s, [[Speedy|Speedies]], [[Slow]]s and [[Hidden]]s.
**''Summon'' ability functionality changed.
***Now lasts between 5 and 8 seconds.
***Enemies are not all summoned at once, one enemy will spawn which will apply a delay before another enemy can spawn. Delay and chance of an enemy spawning depends on the enemy.
**''Stomp'' damage increased from 100 to 900.
**''Shovel'' ability added.
**Updated appearance and animations.

===Maps===
*[[Cyber City]] remade.

===Miscellaneous===
*[[Easy Mode|Easy]] changed.
**Wave structure changed.
**Ambient music added.
**Corrected rewards listed in the mode description as they were inaccurate.
**Fixed final wave music not playing.
*[[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} rewards formula changed.
*[[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode changed.
**Wave structure changed.
**Updated ambient music.
**{{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} rewards increased.
*[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode {{Coins|Coins}} rewards formula changed.
*[[Pizza Party]] {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} rewards formula changed.
*[[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode {{Exp|}} rewards formula changed.
*Updated upgrade UI.
**Mobile touch now uses tap in world.
**Changed button activation event for proper mobile clicks.
**Optimized tool tips.
**Added console keybinds for multiple actions in the upgrade menu.
**Added toggling upgrade UI upon clicking a selected tower.
